subject: Eval readiness & action grid — next steps and owners
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@greentech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Eval readiness & action grid — next steps and owners

Hi Samantha,

Great to meet today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed action grid to get the 3-week evaluation started next Monday.

Key success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: 95th percentile under 400ms for your 256-token prompt mix
- Cost: < $0.10 per 1k tokens for non-streaming inference (target to evaluate in week 2)
- Security: VPC + customer-managed KMS; no logs stored beyond 30 days
- App integration: End-to-end validation of embedding similarity and reranking across 5 sample apps

Suggested evaluation plan (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): infra readiness, account & procurement, baseline dataset upload
2) Week 1: smoke tests + latency/cost profiling
3) Week 2: quality evaluation on your prompts, parity tests
4) Week 3: consolidation, report, go/no-go decision

Owners (initial):
- Infra provisioning & VPC: Redwood infra (Karthik Iyer)
- App integration & test harness: GreenTech (Samantha) + Redwood SDK support (Marissa Cole)
- Security/compliance sign-off: GreenTech SecOps (procurement@greentech.com) + Redwood security
- Procurement & PO: GreenTech procurement

Next steps (proposed, please confirm):
- Samantha to confirm PO contact and target start date (by EOD Thu)
- Redwood to send Eval Action Grid (sheet) and infra checklist (Irene)
- Karthik to confirm estimated time to provision a dedicated sandbox (by Fri)

Attachments: eval-action-grid.xlsx (sheet), infra-checklist.pdf (stub)

Shared links:
- Action grid: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aXbEvalGrid
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890

Happy to jump on a 15-min sync if useful — propose Friday 10am PT.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai

Thanks Irene — this looks good. A few clarifications:
- Security: our SecOps requires SOC2 evidence and a network diagram. Can Redwood provide an architecture diagram and SOC2 attestation? (copying procurement)
- Start date: procurement needs a PO; target we can get the PO approved by Nov 27, so can we start provisioning Nov 29?
- Test data: we'll upload a sanitized subset of our corpus by Friday; I'll share SFTP details with Marissa.

Procurement contact: procurement@greentech.com

I'll take Friday 10am PT if you want to walk through the grid.

Best,
